title: Strategy
summary: Venture, product and movement strategy, from first concept through positioning and scale.
detail: We work alongside founders and leadership teams to decide what to build, who it is for, and why it wins: the venture concept, product strategy, market positioning, and the order of moves that takes an idea from a first conversation to scale.

For movements and networks, strategy also means a theory of change and a plan for growing a community around it. Most often this is an embedded advisory role next to the CEO, covering strategy alongside communications, fundraising and business development.

title: Feasibility
summary: Technical, financial and site feasibility worked out before capital is committed, including cost estimates and concept designs.
detail: Before money goes into land, tooling or a build, we test whether the idea holds up: the engineering and technical risks, the costs and the financial model, and the conditions on the site itself.
The result is something a decision can be made on: cost estimates, concept designs, and a clear list of what has to be true for the project to work.

title: Design
summary: Product, UI/UX, visual and systems design, with design systems that carry from mockup to production.
detail: Design covers the product, the interface, the visual language and the system underneath them. We build design systems (tokens, type, components) so that what is approved in a mockup is what ships in production.
Our principals include product, UI/UX and graphic designers, and we bring in more design talent when a project calls for it.

title: Brand, story & communications
summary: Story, value proposition, brand positioning and the materials that carry them.
detail: A clear story lets funders, customers and partners understand a venture quickly. We work out the narrative and the value proposition first, then the brand positioning and identity.
From there we make the materials that carry it: websites, landing pages, pitch materials, explainer videos and ongoing content.

title: Software & AI products
summary: Custom AI-powered software, designed and built end to end.
detail: Applied Alchemy designs and builds custom AI-powered software for organizations that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools. Principal Edward West leads each engagement from strategy and specification through design, build, and deployment, so a small team ships working software in weeks.

title: Hardware & engineering
summary: Prototype design, engineering and fabrication for vehicles, powertrains and building systems.
detail: We design, engineer and build physical prototypes, from the first test rig to a vehicle on the track, and bring in industrial designers and power electronics engineers from our network to get there.
The same hands-on engineering carries into buildings: Kohala’s panelized flat-pack system applies vehicle-style design for manufacture to durable, fire-resilient homes.

title: Supply chain & manufacturing
summary: We help companies take prototypes to production scale, domestic, nearshore, and overseas.
detail: Getting from prototype to production means deciding where and how a product gets made: finding and qualifying suppliers and manufacturers, reaching a workable production cost, and keeping quality and logistics under control as volumes grow.
We have done this for vehicles and powertrains, and for a panelized building system that has to arrive on site as a complete kit.

title: Fundraising & capital
summary: Fundraising materials and investor outreach, matching each innovation with the right type of capital.
detail: Not every venture should raise the same way. We help match each one with the capital that fits it, whether venture investment, philanthropy, grants or blended structures.
Then we build the materials (narrative, pitch deck and supporting documents) and run the outreach to investors, funders and partners.

title: Business development & go-to-market
detail: We find the first customers and partners and build the path to more: target markets, pricing and channels, the sales process, and partnerships with companies that already reach the customer.
Where it helps, we lead sales ourselves rather than only advising on it.

title: Team building & leadership
summary: Assembling founding teams, recruiting, and leading ventures as executives.
detail: New ventures rise or fall on their first team. We recruit founders, early engineers, advisors and board members from a network built over two decades.
When a venture needs it, we step into executive roles ourselves, as co-founders, presidents and CEOs.

title: Networks & ecosystems
summary: Convening stakeholders, forging alliances, building networks, and seeding movements.
detail: Some problems need many organizations moving together. We convene the right people, design the gatherings, and set up the structures for ongoing collaboration.
From there we help a network grow into a movement, with prizes, accelerators, communities of practice and the funds that support them.
